assertions.assertion: The claim is for CPT code 93229.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197.
CO-197 indicates precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's presentation.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations.
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is coded as I48.0.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease.
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded as I25.10.
Diagnosis code I48.91 was also submitted.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
A formal appeal is being submitted with supporting clinical documentation.
